about: Small designs with metric values worked out by hand, read by both engines (test/ui/metrics.test.ts, test/python/test_metrics.py). Rows run from y = 0 upwards; a digit is a building of that many storeys, L landscape, W water. 20 m squares, no roads.

cases.name: stripes: building and landscape in alternate columns

why.rhythm_built: each 16-cell row alternates 1, 0: all its variation is in the period-2 repeat
why.contrast: 60 side-by-side links all differ, 48 up-and-down links never do: 60 / 108
why.dh_enclosure: 60 street faces; all face one 20 m open cell then a 9.6 m building (D/H 2.1) except the 4 on the last column, which face the edge: 56 / 60
why.block_size: each block is one column of 4 cells, 10 edges round, 200 m
why.gradients: no neighbouring buildings differ in height
why.use_mix: half building, half landscape: ln 2 / ln 3

cases.name: pond: a 2 x 2 pond in a field of four-storey buildings

why.the_void: the only open space is 4 of 64 cells
why.boundaries: the pond's 8 outer edges all touch buildings
why.positive_space: a 40 m square is its own convex hull
why.junctions: the pond touches one block only
